Section Header: Date windows (UVWINDOW) - live anchor on this page
Field Note: Type 2026-03-01. The next three fields count from this date. Clear it: their windows switch off.

Field Label: Visit 21 to 35 days after the anchor (hard)
Field Note: With anchor 2026-03-01: 2026-03-22 and 2026-04-05 pass, 2026-03-21 and 2026-04-06 fail and block the save. The message names 2026-03-22 and 2026-04-05.

Field Label: Within a week of the anchor (D-M-Y display)
Field Note: Typed as D-M-Y. With anchor 2026-03-01: 08-03-2026 passes, 09-03-2026 fails. The message shows 01-03-2026 and 08-03-2026.

Field Label: Two weeks either side, not in the future (custom message)
Field Note: With anchor 2026-03-01: 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-15 pass, 2026-02-14 fails with the custom message. Tomorrow fails too; the audit logs it as future.
Field Annotation: @UVWINDOW={"from":"[uw_anchor]","window":[-2,2],"unit":"weeks","notFuture":true,"message":"Must be within two weeks of the anchor date and not in the future."}

Field Note: Yes switches on the window of the next field. No or blank: no check.

Field Label: Within 10 days of the anchor, only while the gate is Yes
Field Note: Gate Yes, anchor 2026-03-01: 2026-03-12 fails. Set the gate to No: the message disappears.

Section Header: Not in the future, server clock
Field Note: Today passes. Tomorrow fails and blocks. Set the computer clock a day ahead and reload: tomorrow still fails, because today is the server's date.
Now passes. Five minutes from now fails with: This date and time is in the future.

Field Label: Sample within 6 hours of the dose (D-M-Y datetime)

Section Header: Anchors elsewhere (read when the page opens)
Field Label: Within 30 days of consent (Enrolment form, hard)
Field Note: Counts from the consent date on the xe_enrol form. XE-1 consent is 2026-01-10: 2026-02-09 passes, 2026-02-10 fails but does NOT block the save, and the message says the date was read when the page was opened.

Field Label: 14 to 60 days after the Baseline visit (other event)
Field Note: Needs event and instance references ON. XE-1 Baseline visit date is 2026-01-15: 2026-01-29 passes, 2026-03-17 fails, advisory.

Section Header: Uniqueness on a D-M-Y date (fix in this release)
Field Note: Save 15-03-2026 on record XE-1. On XE-2 type 15-03-2026 and leave the field: it must say the value is already recorded.
